items.title: Australians need better understanding of Holocaust, professor tells inquiry
items.description: A Monash University professor has told the Royal Commission on Antisemitism and Social Cohesion of the importance of Holocaust teachings.

items.title: Landslide buries people, destroys buildings in south-western China
items.description: A landslide in south-western China's Chongqing province has buried people in rubble and destroyed a roadway and a number of buildings, according to state media.

items.title: Treasurer says AI key to raising productivity, lowering interest rates
items.description: The Treasurer has given an insight into his April meeting with Anthropic, arguing that Australia embracing AI is crucial for turning around the nation's lacklustre productivity and economic performance over recent decades.

items.title: US hits more bridges in Iran in expansion of its air strike campaign
items.description: The United States has expanded its air strike campaign against Iran by increasingly hitting bridges, part of President Donald Trump's threats to start striking infrastructure to pressure Tehran to ease its chokehold on the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: UK urges FIFA to act after Argentine players hold up Malvinas banner
items.description: The British government urges FIFA to investigate after Argentine players held up a banner declaring the Falkland Islands were Argentinian.

items.title: Live: Trump claims China acquired personal information of 220m US voters
items.description: Donald Trump claims declassified documents reveal  China carried out the "largest compromise of election data in history". Follow live.

items.title: Hanson laments end of White Australia policy on Tommy Robinson podcast
items.description: One Nation leader Pauline Hanson has blamed the end of the White Australia policy for migration issues in the country during a controversial podcast appearance with a far-right activist in the UK.

items.title: Live: Telstra has issued credit worth $100,000 in compensation so far
items.description: Telstra CEO Vicki Brady is appearing before a Senate hearing over the over the nationwide outage, and potential compensation. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: Drivers wait months for faults to be repaired on EVs built by new brands
items.description: As an influx of car brands enters the market, dealers ask for a change to consumer laws to fix a grey area that makes them responsible for warranty repairs.

items.title: Parents go against court orders after children 'traumatised'
items.description: The Family Court granted John full custody of his kids, but he returned them to their mother, saying the judge got it wrong.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
